method.purpose: Test proximity to published no-parking, mandatory-parking, and no-ride boundaries.
method.distance: Nearest point-to-polygon-boundary distance using a local equirectangular approximation.
method.interpretation: Proximity is an operational correlation signal only. It does not establish that a policy boundary caused a complaint, that the policy was active at report time, or that a vehicle was inside a prohibited area.
